to: everyone near the source (`xy_emit`): players and observers. A rogue or an invisible character nearer than 300 px gets the form with `affected` instead

fields.name: name
fields.description: The source: the name of the character that used `light`, or the id of the monster.

fields.name: affected
fields.description: Only to a rogue, or to an invisible character, nearer than 300 px: the light found you. The server removes your `invis` condition and sends you `player` (node/server_functions.js:3762-3766).

confirm.note: `xy_emit` sends `{name}` to everyone in view; the form with `affected` is built in `xy_emit` itself (node/server_functions.js:3762-3766)

senders.what: The tick of the instance: a monster with the `mlight` ability
